content.actor.fox.name: 狐狸
content.cast.dusk.inga.0.bark.0: 当心楼梯。楼梯可不当心你。
content.cast.opening.inga.0.bark.0: 当心楼梯。楼梯可不当心你。
content.cast.the-festival.agathe.0.bark.0: 六十一届庆典，没有一届不出岔子。出了岔子，才叫庆典。
content.cast.the-festival.bernt.0.bark.0: 烟花在库房里。库房钥匙嘛，眼下在一只狐狸嘴里。
content.cast.the-festival.inga.0.bark.0: 当心楼梯。楼梯可不当心你。
content.cast.the-festival.kettil.0.bark.0: 三只山羊，其中一只是麻烦精。
content.cast.the-festival.oskar.0.bark.0: 蛋糕正在静置。蛋糕旁边谁都不许摔门。
content.cast.the-festival.sverre.0.bark.0: 宴席的六箱货漂在海湾里。划轻点，箱子怕生。
content.cast.the-festival.vidar.0.bark.0: 镇规第十四条：黄昏鸣钟。第十四条可没料到绳子会断。
content.cast.the-fox.bernt.0.bark.0: 烟花在库房里。库房钥匙嘛，眼下在一只狐狸嘴里。
content.cast.the-fox.inga.0.bark.0: 当心楼梯。楼梯可不当心你。
content.class.archer.blurb: 年年射箭比赛的头名。带着弓、一壶箭和面包。
content.class.archer.kit.0.name: 头名之弓
content.class.archer.name: 弓手
content.class.cook.blurb: 不管谁饿不饿都要喂上一口。一面其实是托盘的盾、一把剁刀、几块馅饼。
content.class.cook.kit.0.name: 上菜托盘
content.class.cook.kit.1.name: 剁刀
content.class.cook.name: 厨子
content.class.runner.blurb: 整天在镇子上下跑腿送信。一双轻靴、一把劈柴斧、面包。
content.class.runner.kit.0.name: 跑腿靴
content.class.runner.kit.1.name: 劈柴斧
content.class.runner.name: 跑腿
content.class.watch.blurb: 庆典日维持秩序。带着剑、皮背心和面包。
content.class.watch.kit.0.name: 巡夜剑
content.class.watch.kit.1.name: 巡夜皮背心
content.class.watch.name: 巡夜人
content.containers.decoration_notice: 镇上的木桶、箱子和柜子里装的都是主人家的东西：随便看，但别乱翻。
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-day.opt.0.label: 祝你好运。
content.dlg.agathe.agathe-day.text: 亲爱的，这样的庆典我看了六十一届，每一届都差点办不成。去吧。今晚我坐第一排。
content.dlg.bernt.bernt-day.opt.0.label: 祝你好运。
content.dlg.bernt.bernt-day.text: 一只狐狸。进了我的库房。叼走了我的钥匙。现在它叼着钥匙往山路上跑了，谁逮住它之前，烟花都锁在里面。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-day.opt.0.label: 笑着呢。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-day.text: 进展如何？别告诉我。黄昏再告诉我。对着镇上的人笑一笑。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-dusk.opt.0.label: 守着呢。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-dusk.text: 守住街口！谁也别碰蛋糕！
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-morning.opt.0.label: 那边在嚷什么？
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-morning.opt.1.label: 我们来帮忙。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-morning.opt.1.tooltip: 交给我们：不管出了什么岔子，黄昏前都给你摆平。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-morning.text: 早上好，凯尔德比！早上好，新来的朋友们！今天是庆典：广场上摆宴席，黄昏敲钟，灯塔的灯照着海湾，午夜城堡放烟花。绝对不可能出任何岔子。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-night.opt.0.label: 开始吧。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-night.text: 看看他们。看看这么多人。好吧。今天不管发生了什么，那就是今年的庆典了。我开始了？
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-troubles.opt.0.label: 返回。
content.dlg.hedda.hedda-troubles.text: 那个？那是所有事一起出岔子了。造船匠的货船在海湾里翻了，宴席的东西全在船上。箍桶匠的山羊跑上了梯田。钟绳断了。灯塔的灯半夜灭了，守塔人正在上面骂它。挑一件。全挑也行。黄昏前回到这座舞台。
content.dlg.inga.inga-lamp.opt.0.label: 我们上去。
content.dlg.inga.inga-lamp.text: 凌晨三点灭的。灯芯没事，油也没事，是灯自己在闹脾气。还有，上去的楼梯塌了三处，得跳过去。趁油还没凉把它点着，我欠你们一个人情。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-day.opt.0.label: 祝你好运。
content.dlg.kettil.kettil-day.text: 要是你在不该有山羊的地方看见山羊，那就是我家的。
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-day.opt.0.label: 祝你好运。
content.dlg.oskar.oskar-day.text: 蛋糕做好了。四层，糖渍樱桃，顶上一座糖做的灯塔。黄昏摆上舞台，午夜之前谁也不许对着它喘气。
content.dlg.sverre.sverre-day.opt.0.label: 祝你好运。
content.dlg.sverre.sverre-day.text: 在沙洲上把船弄翻了，可不是嘛。宴席的六箱货在海湾里漂着，有两箱漂到了沙洲外头。
content.dlg.vidar.vidar-day.opt.0.label: 把弓给我。
content.dlg.vidar.vidar-day.opt.0.tooltip: 接过维达的弓箭，去射钟楼里的靶子。
content.dlg.vidar.vidar-day.text: 镇规第十四条：黄昏鸣钟。今早钟绳断了，绳结卡在钟楼窗口的箭靶上，谁也够不着。我有一把弓，可我这辈子一次也没射中过东西。干净利落地射中三箭，就能把绳结震下来。
content.fx.dusk.done.9.narrate: 夜幕降临。全镇的人沿着主街走上广场，庆典开始了。
content.fx.dusk.oc.back-to-the-stage.3.narrate: 海湾里传来号角声。三条挂着条纹帆的矮船：掠夺者来抢庆典了。海达说，他们就是冲着蛋糕来的。
content.fx.dusk.oc.back-to-the-stage.8.narrate: 伯恩特把城堡的弩和白天抢下来的烟花一车拉到了舞台边。“火箭装在放弩箭的地方。对准船。别对准蛋糕。”
content.fx.dusk.oc.back-to-the-stage.9.respawn.0: 你在广场对面旅店酒堂的长凳上醒过来。有人给你留了一块馅饼。
content.fx.dusk.oc.hold-the-beach.0.narrate: 号角声更响了。最后一条船上站起一个人，帽子上的羽毛长得能戳瞎人，他伸手指向蛋糕。
content.fx.dusk.oc.hold-the-dock.0.seq.0.1.narra: 灯塔的光束一转，定住了：港口那头的海滩上有船冲上岸！还有三十口气的工夫。
content.fx.opening.done.0.narrate: 海达对着整个广场喊：“凯尔德比！一切尽在掌握！”她身后有人边跑边喊山羊的事。
content.fx.opening.done.3.narrate: 奥斯卡把庆典蛋糕摆上舞台的桌子：四层高，顶上立着一座糖做的灯塔。
content.fx.the-bell.oc.ring-the-bell.1.narrate: 钟声响彻广场。维达热泪盈眶，说这一声分秒不差，郑重地记进了本子。
content.fx.the-bell.ox.ring-the-bell.0.narrate: 维达把视线从钟楼上收回来。“第十四条只好等等了。晚饭后我扛梯子上去。”钟暂时还是哑的。
content.fx.the-festival.done.0.narrate: 灯塔的光束扫过广场，每一张脸都随着它抬了起来。
content.fx.the-festival.done.1.narrate: 灯塔一直黑着，海达只好就着奥斯卡举着的提灯念稿，大部分都念对了。
content.fx.the-festival.done.10.narrate: 几支烟花一支接一支地升空，每支之间都礼貌地隔上一会儿。全镇的人为每一支都单独欢呼了一遍。
content.fx.the-festival.done.2.narrate: 午夜钟声准时敲响，庆典开始了。
content.fx.the-festival.done.3.narrate: 海达的致辞念到一半，维达终于把钟敲响了，全广场为这次打断欢呼起来。
content.fx.the-festival.done.4.narrate: 奥斯卡的蛋糕好端端地立在舞台上，四层，顶上一座糖灯塔，一点没碰着。
content.fx.the-festival.done.5.narrate: 海达对着蛋糕的空盘子致了祝酒词，全镇的人也举杯敬那只盘子。
content.fx.the-festival.done.9.narrate: 城堡的烟花铺满了整片夜空，一直放到镇上的狗都叫累了。
content.fx.the-fox.done.2.narrate: 正午了。广场上海达摇着一只手铃（这可不是庆典的钟），喊大家傍晚都回舞台来。
content.fx.the-fox.oc.corner-the-fox.1.narrate: 狐狸叼着钥匙在窝前坐下，看着你，好像不讲理的是你。
content.fx.the-fox.oc.fetch-the-fireworks.1.narr: 库房里的烟花一直堆到房梁。伯恩特在你身边说了声“哦，太好了”，听语气他早就不抱希望了。
content.fx.the-fox.oc.flush-1.0.narrate: 狐狸从藏身处窜出来，沿着山路一溜烟往上跑。
content.fx.the-fox.oc.flush-2.0.narrate: 狐狸从藏身处窜出来，沿着山路一溜烟往上跑。
content.fx.the-fox.oc.flush-3.0.narrate: 狐狸从藏身处窜出来，沿着山路一溜烟往上跑。
content.fx.the-fox.oc.flush-4.0.narrate: 狐狸从藏身处窜出来，沿着山路一溜烟往上跑。
content.fx.the-fox.ox.fetch-the-fireworks.0.narr: 等你赶到库房，伯恩特已经让马童把一半烟花搬下山了，最上面那层剩下的引信也被狐狸啃了。那就只有半场烟花了。
content.fx.the-lamp.done.3.narrate: 英嘉的声音顺着楼梯井传上来：“既然上去了，就用我的望远镜看看。城堡山路上一上午都不太平。”
content.fx.the-lamp.oc.light-the-lamp.2.narrate: 灯亮了，光束扫过海湾。远远在下面的英嘉欢呼了一声，然后装作没出过声。
content.fx.the-lamp.ox.light-the-lamp.0.narrate: 英嘉在下面远远地喊，罐里的油已经凉了。今晚灯塔不会亮了。
content.fx.trig.belfry-shot.1.narrate: 咚。靶子上的绳结跳了一下。
content.fx.trig.cake-taken-pillager.2.narrate: 一个掠夺者跳上舞台，一把抢走奥斯卡的蛋糕，消失在暮色里。
content.fx.trig.cake-taken-vindicator.2.narrate: 一个掠夺者跳上舞台，一把抢走奥斯卡的蛋糕，消失在暮色里。
content.fx.trig.ring-for-glow.4.narrate: 钟声轰鸣，镇上每个掠夺者都像灯笼一样亮了起来。
content.fx.trig.spot-the-fox.1.narrate: 望远镜里：城堡山路上，一只狐狸叼着亮闪闪的东西往山上小跑。英嘉在楼梯下眯着眼往上喊：“那是伯恩特的库房钥匙。烟花全锁在里面。”
content.fx.trig.take-the-key.2.narrate: 狐狸打量了你好一会儿，才张开嘴让你把钥匙拿走。它看起来很受伤。

content.obj.dusk.back-to-the-stage.hint: 沿主街上到广场，海达正在招呼大家回来。
content.obj.dusk.back-to-the-stage.title: 回到舞台
content.obj.dusk.hold-the-beach.hint: 从灯塔那边沿崖边小路过来，正穿过最后一条小巷往上走。
content.obj.dusk.hold-the-beach.title: 击退海滩登陆
content.obj.dusk.hold-the-dock.hint: 沿主街往下朝码头去：从船上上来的掠夺者。
content.obj.dusk.hold-the-dock.title: 击退码头登陆
content.obj.dusk.stop-the-captain.hint: 从码头沿主街上来：船长和他最后的进攻。
content.obj.dusk.stop-the-captain.title: 拦住船长
content.obj.opening.hear-the-host.hint: 广场上的舞台，就在大教堂正门旁边。
content.obj.opening.hear-the-host.title: 听主持人讲话
content.obj.the-bell.ask-vidar.hint: 主街最上头，广场下面一点：拿着弓的那位书记员。
content.obj.the-bell.ask-vidar.title: 找书记员谈谈
content.obj.the-bell.ring-the-bell.answers.not_y: 铛的一声闷响。绳结还卡在钟楼上。
content.obj.the-bell.ring-the-bell.hint: 站在主街顶端，往钟楼开口里的标靶射三箭。然后去教堂前院敲钟。
content.obj.the-bell.ring-the-bell.title: 射钟楼的靶子
content.obj.the-festival.open-the-festival.hint: 广场上的舞台，全镇的人都在那儿等着。
content.obj.the-festival.open-the-festival.title: 请海达开场
content.obj.the-fox.corner-the-fox.hint: 城堡山路的尽头，城门旁边：门前路堤下的狐狸窝。
content.obj.the-fox.corner-the-fox.title: 把狐狸堵住
content.obj.the-fox.fetch-the-fireworks.hint: 城堡里，下到地窖：管家的烟花库房。
content.obj.the-fox.fetch-the-fireworks.title: 取出烟花
content.obj.the-fox.flush-1.hint: 从广场沿城堡山路往上，到路边的泉水那儿。
content.obj.the-fox.flush-1.title: 找到狐狸
content.obj.the-fox.flush-2.hint: 沿城堡山路继续往上，到路边的蜂园，狐狸跑到那儿去了。
content.obj.the-fox.flush-2.title: 追狐狸
content.obj.the-fox.flush-3.hint: 沿城堡山路继续往上，到路边的牧人小屋，狐狸跑到那儿去了。
content.obj.the-fox.flush-3.title: 追狐狸
content.obj.the-fox.flush-4.hint: 沿城堡山路继续往上，到路边的瞭望台，狐狸跑到那儿去了。
content.obj.the-fox.flush-4.title: 追狐狸
content.obj.the-lamp.ask-inga.hint: 沿主街往下，在最后一条小巷左转，顺着崖边小路走到白色灯塔。
content.obj.the-lamp.ask-inga.title: 找守塔人谈谈
content.obj.the-lamp.climb-the-tower.hint: 沿塔内楼梯往上：台阶断了的地方，跳过去。
content.obj.the-lamp.climb-the-tower.title: 爬上灯室
content.obj.the-lamp.light-the-lamp.hint: 塔顶的灯室里：正中间那盏大灯。
content.obj.the-lamp.light-the-lamp.title: 点亮大灯
content.quest.dusk.goal: 黄昏回到舞台，把三拨登陆的掠夺者赶出庆典。
content.quest.opening.goal: 听主持人在舞台上宣布庆典开幕，然后听着所有事一齐出岔子。
content.quest.the-bell.goal: 在时限之前用三箭把断绳的结从钟楼靶子上射下来，再敲响庆典的钟。
content.quest.the-festival.goal: 在夜里办起庆典，白天办成了什么，庆典就是什么样子。
content.quest.the-fox.goal: 沿城堡山路追着狐狸从一个藏身处到下一个，一直追到它的窝，再及时从城堡库房取出烟花。
content.quest.the-lamp.goal: 越过断掉的楼梯爬上灯塔，赶在时限之前点亮大灯。
content.trigger.ring-for-glow.answers.not_yet: 钟还在嗡嗡作响，等一下再敲。
content.trigger.take-the-key.answers.done: 狐狸除了一个白眼，已经没什么可给你的了。
content.trigger.take-the-key.answers.not_yet: 狐狸躲开你的手，死死叼着它的宝贝。

content.wave.dock-landing.health_bar.title: 码头上的掠夺者

source.actor.fox.name: The Fox
source.cast.dusk.inga.0.bark.0: Mind the stairs. The stairs do not mind you.
source.cast.opening.inga.0.bark.0: Mind the stairs. The stairs do not mind you.
source.cast.the-festival.agathe.0.bark.0: Sixty-one festivals, and every one of them went wrong somewhere. That is how you know it is the festival.
source.cast.the-festival.bernt.0.bark.0: The fireworks are in the storeroom. The storeroom key is, at present, in a fox.
source.cast.the-festival.inga.0.bark.0: Mind the stairs. The stairs do not mind you.
source.cast.the-festival.kettil.0.bark.0: Three goats, and one of them is the problem.
source.cast.the-festival.oskar.0.bark.0: The cake is resting. Do not slam any doors near the cake.
source.cast.the-festival.sverre.0.bark.0: Six crates of the feast in the bay. Row gently. Crates are shy.
source.cast.the-festival.vidar.0.bark.0: By-law fourteen: the bell rings at dusk. By-law fourteen did not foresee the rope.
source.cast.the-fox.bernt.0.bark.0: The fireworks are in the storeroom. The storeroom key is, at present, in a fox.
source.cast.the-fox.inga.0.bark.0: Mind the stairs. The stairs do not mind you.
source.class.archer.blurb: Wins the archery prize every year. Carries a bow, a quiver and bread.
source.class.archer.kit.0.name: Prize Bow
source.class.archer.name: The Archer
source.class.cook.blurb: Feeds everybody whether they asked or not. A shield that is mostly a tray, a cleaver and pies.
source.class.cook.kit.0.name: Serving Tray
source.class.cook.kit.1.name: Cleaver
source.class.cook.name: The Cook
source.class.runner.blurb: Carries messages up and down the town all day. Light boots, an axe for the woodpile, bread.
source.class.runner.kit.0.name: Runner's Boots
source.class.runner.kit.1.name: Woodpile Axe
source.class.runner.name: The Runner
source.class.watch.blurb: Keeps the peace on festival day. Carries a sword, a jerkin and bread.
source.class.watch.kit.0.name: Watch Sword
source.class.watch.kit.1.name: Watch Jerkin
source.class.watch.name: The Watch
source.containers.decoration_notice: The barrels, crates and cupboards of the town hold their owners' goods: look all you like, but they are not yours to open.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-day.opt.0.label: Good luck.
source.dlg.agathe.agathe-day.text: My dear, I have watched sixty-one of these festivals and every one of them nearly did not happen. Go on. I shall be in the front row tonight.
source.dlg.bernt.bernt-day.opt.0.label: Good luck.
source.dlg.bernt.bernt-day.text: A fox. In MY storeroom. With MY key. And now it is off up the road with it, and the fireworks are locked in until somebody catches it.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-day.opt.0.label: Smiling.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-day.text: How is it going? Don't tell me. Tell me at dusk. Smile at the town.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-dusk.opt.0.label: Holding.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-dusk.text: Hold the street! Nobody touches the cake!
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-morning.opt.0.label: What's that shouting?
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-morning.opt.1.label: We'll help.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-morning.opt.1.tooltip: Leave it to us: whatever has gone wrong, we'll put it right before dusk.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-morning.text: Good morning, Kelderby! Good morning, new faces! Today is the festival: a feast on the square, the bell at dusk, the lighthouse lamp over the bay and the castle's fireworks at midnight. Nothing can possibly go wrong.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-night.opt.0.label: Begin.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-night.text: Look at them. Look at all of them. Right. Whatever happened today, that is the festival now. Shall I begin?
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-troubles.opt.0.label: Back.
source.dlg.hedda.hedda-troubles.text: That? That is everything going wrong at once. The boatwright's cargo boat has turned over in the bay with the feast in it. The cooper's goats are up the terraces. The bell rope has snapped. And the lighthouse lamp went out in the night, and the keeper is up there swearing at it. Pick one. Pick all of them. Be back on this stage by dusk.
source.dlg.inga.inga-lamp.opt.0.label: We're going up.
source.dlg.inga.inga-lamp.opt.0.tooltip: Climb the tower and light the lamp.
source.dlg.inga.inga-lamp.text: Went out at three this morning. Wick's fine, oil's fine, the lamp is sulking. Also the stairs gave way in three places on the way up, so you'll be jumping. Light it before the oil goes cold and I'll owe you.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-day.opt.0.label: Good luck.
source.dlg.kettil.kettil-day.text: If you see a goat anywhere it shouldn't be, it's one of mine.
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-day.opt.0.label: Good luck.
source.dlg.oskar.oskar-day.text: The cake is done. Four tiers, candied cherries, a sugar lighthouse on top. It goes on the stage at dusk and nobody breathes on it until midnight.
source.dlg.sverre.sverre-day.opt.0.label: Good luck.
source.dlg.sverre.sverre-day.text: Turned her over on the bar, didn't I. Six crates of the feast bobbing about in the bay. Two of them went out past the sandbar.
source.dlg.vidar.vidar-day.opt.0.label: Give me the bow.
source.dlg.vidar.vidar-day.opt.0.tooltip: Take Vidar's bow and arrows and shoot the target in the bell tower.
source.dlg.vidar.vidar-day.text: By-law fourteen: the bell rings at dusk. The rope snapped this morning, and the knot is caught on the archery target up in the tower's opening, where nobody can reach it. I have a bow. I have never once hit anything with it. Three clean hits would shake the knot free.
source.fx.dusk.done.9.narrate: Night. The whole town comes up the main street to the square, and the festival begins.
source.fx.dusk.oc.back-to-the-stage.3.narrate: A horn from the bay. Three low boats with striped sails: raiders, come for the festival and, says Hedda, very specifically for the cake.
source.fx.dusk.oc.back-to-the-stage.8.narrate: Bernt has carted the castle's crossbows down to the stage with whatever rockets the day saved. 'Load the rocket where the bolt goes. Point it at the boats. Not at the cake.'
source.fx.dusk.oc.back-to-the-stage.9.respawn.0: You come round on a bench in the inn's taproom across the square. Somebody has left you a pie.
source.fx.dusk.oc.hold-the-beach.0.narrate: A bigger horn. A man in a hat with a feather that could take an eye out stands up in the last boat and points at the cake.
source.fx.dusk.oc.hold-the-dock.0.seq.0.1.narra: The lighthouse beam swings round and holds: boats running up on the beach past the harbour! Thirty breaths away.
source.fx.opening.done.0.narrate: Hedda, to the whole square: 'Kelderby! Everything is under control!' Behind her, somebody runs past shouting about goats.
source.fx.opening.done.3.narrate: Oskar sets the festival cake on its table on the stage: four tiers and a sugar lighthouse.
source.fx.the-bell.oc.ring-the-bell.1.narrate: The bell rings out over the square. Vidar, with tears in his eyes, says it is exactly on time, and notes it in his book.
source.fx.the-bell.ox.ring-the-bell.0.narrate: Vidar lowers his eyes from the tower. 'By-law fourteen will have to wait. I shall go up with a ladder after supper.' The bell stays silent for now.
source.fx.the-festival.done.0.narrate: The lighthouse beam sweeps over the square, and every face turns up into it as it passes.
source.fx.the-festival.done.1.narrate: The lighthouse stays dark, so Hedda reads her speech by a lantern Oskar holds up for her, and gets most of it right.
source.fx.the-festival.done.10.narrate: A few rockets go up, one after another, a polite gap between each. The town cheers every one of them, individually.
source.fx.the-festival.done.2.narrate: On the stroke of midnight the festival bell rings the festival in.
source.fx.the-festival.done.3.narrate: Halfway through Hedda's speech, Vidar finally gets the bell to ring, and the whole square cheers the interruption.
source.fx.the-festival.done.4.narrate: Oskar's cake stands on the stage, four tiers and a sugar lighthouse, without a mark on it.
source.fx.the-festival.done.5.narrate: Hedda gives the toast to the cake's empty plate, and the town toasts the plate.
source.fx.the-festival.done.9.narrate: The castle's fireworks fill the whole sky over the town, and keep filling it until the dogs give up barking.
source.fx.the-fox.done.2.narrate: Noon. Down on the square Hedda is ringing a handbell, which is not the festival bell, and shouting for everybody to come back to the stage for the evening.
source.fx.the-fox.oc.corner-the-fox.1.narrate: The fox sits down in front of its den with the key in its mouth and looks at you as if you were the one being unreasonable.
source.fx.the-fox.oc.fetch-the-fireworks.1.narr: The storeroom is stacked to the rafters with rockets. Bernt, at your elbow, says 'Oh, good,' in a voice that means he had given up.
source.fx.the-fox.oc.flush-1.0.narrate: The fox bolts out from cover and streaks on up the road.
source.fx.the-fox.oc.flush-2.0.narrate: The fox bolts out from cover and streaks on up the road.
source.fx.the-fox.oc.flush-3.0.narrate: The fox bolts out from cover and streaks on up the road.
source.fx.the-fox.oc.flush-4.0.narrate: The fox bolts out from cover and streaks on up the road.
source.fx.the-fox.ox.fetch-the-fireworks.0.narr: By the time you reach the storeroom, Bernt has sent half the rockets down the hill with the stable boys, and the fox has chewed the fuses on the rest of the top shelf. Half a show, then.
source.fx.the-lamp.done.3.narrate: Inga's voice comes up the stairwell: 'While you're up there, have a look through my spyglass. Something has been bothering the castle road all morning.'
source.fx.the-lamp.oc.light-the-lamp.2.narrate: The lamp catches, and the beam swings out over the bay. Inga, far below, cheers once and then pretends she didn't.
source.fx.the-lamp.ox.light-the-lamp.0.narrate: From far below, Inga shouts that the oil has gone cold in the can. The lamp stays dark tonight.
source.fx.trig.belfry-shot.1.narrate: Thock. The rope's knot jumps on the target.
source.fx.trig.cake-taken-pillager.2.narrate: A raider bounds onto the stage, snatches Oskar's cake and is gone with it into the dusk.
source.fx.trig.cake-taken-vindicator.2.narrate: A raider bounds onto the stage, snatches Oskar's cake and is gone with it into the dusk.
source.fx.trig.ring-for-glow.4.narrate: The bell booms, and every raider in the town lights up like a lantern.
source.fx.trig.spot-the-fox.1.narrate: Through the spyglass: on the castle road, a fox trotting uphill with something bright in its mouth. Inga squints up the stair: 'That's Bernt's storeroom key. The fireworks are locked in there.'
source.fx.trig.take-the-key.2.narrate: The fox considers you for a long moment, then opens its mouth and lets you take the key. It looks offended.

source.obj.the-lamp.light-the-lamp.answers.not_: A cold lamp, its wick dry.
source.obj.the-lamp.light-the-lamp.hint: In the lamp room at the top of the tower: the great lamp in the middle.
source.obj.the-lamp.light-the-lamp.title: Light the lamp
source.quest.dusk.goal: Come back to the stage at dusk and drive three landings of raiders off the festival.
source.quest.opening.goal: Hear the host open the festival on the stage, and hear everything go wrong at once.
source.quest.the-bell.goal: Shoot the snapped rope's knot off the target in the bell tower with three arrows, and ring the festival bell, before the window closes.
source.quest.the-festival.goal: Hold the festival at night, made of whatever the day managed.
source.quest.the-fox.goal: Chase the fox up the castle road from hiding place to hiding place to its den, and fetch the fireworks from the castle storeroom in time.
source.quest.the-lamp.goal: Climb the lighthouse past its broken stairs and light the lamp before the window closes.
source.trigger.ring-for-glow.answers.not_yet: The bell is still humming. Give it a moment.
source.trigger.take-the-key.answers.done: The fox has nothing left to give you but a look.
source.trigger.take-the-key.answers.not_yet: The fox shies away from your hand and keeps its prize.
